notes.title: Tiny Shop: sweet updates and something special! 🐾
notes.notes:
[p]Hi friends! 👋
Sorry I haven’t shared any updates in a while. I’ve been fully focused on working on the demo. And maybe you already have an idea for their name?

Rostislav[/p]

notes.title: 🌸 Welcome to Tiny Shop: Make It Cozy! 🌸
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

My name is Rostislav, and I’m the solo developer behind Tiny Shop: Make It Cozy. I’m thrilled to finally share the game with you the Steam page is live, and so is our very first trailer! 🎉
You can check it out right here on the page.
[previewyoutube=mvRnR4_5yDc;full][/previewyoutube]

🛒 What's Tiny Shop all about?
Tiny Shop is a cozy and relaxing shop simulator where you decorate, manage, and sell charming little things handmade candles, soft knitted scarves, vintage flea market treasures, and more.

Your shop sits on a quiet street filled with warm light and the smell of fresh coffee. Customers stop by not just for the goods, but for the peaceful atmosphere you create.

There are no time limits, no pressure, and no stress  just the joy of arranging shelves, chatting with regulars, and making your tiny shop feel like home.

✨ Why I made this game
I always dreamed of quitting everything and opening a small shop. This game is my way of bringing that dream to life and sharing the feeling of calm, creativity, and slow living.

If you love decorating, cozy vibes, and games where you can just be, I think you’ll feel right at home here.

💌 Stay in touch!
If you like the idea of Tiny Shop, it would mean a lot if you added it to your Steam Wishlist. It really helps more than you know!
You can also follow along for future updates or drop me a message I’d love to hear what you think.

Thanks so much for reading  and for supporting tiny, cozy indie games like this one.

With warm wishes,
Rostislav ☕🏠
